tools.name: stamp
tools.description: Recommended agent path. Request a signed, citable statement for a SHA-256 (sit-statement/0.1). Same as the signed-out curl: curl -s -X POST https://soulintime.com/functions/createMoment -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"sha256Hash":"<64 hex>"}'. First one free, no account; one fresh hash per

tools.name: verify

tools.name: first_at
tools.description: Use verify to cite; first_at only for earliest height. Secondary, read-only: the earliest confirmed public receipt for a hash, optionally at or before a height. Not needed to cite.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify · Private data: stamp, verify · Public sink: stamp, verify · Destructive: verify.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify · Private data: stamp, verify · Public sink: stamp, verify · Destructive: verify

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
